strategies.name: BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION
strategies.guidance: Do not compress/move/delete yet. First login to file_system, show_directory to get absolute paths, print the exact target paths, then perform writes only on those paths.

strategies.name: VERIFY_TARGET_SET
strategies.guidance: Before any write, print the verified set of absolute file/directory paths that the task requires changing. Operate only on that verified set; do not invent relative paths.

strategies.name: REPLAN
strategies.guidance: Abandon the current write plan. Re-plan: supervisor passwords -> file_system.login -> show_directory -> identify targets -> compress/move as required -> verify listing.

strategies.name: LOOKUP_API_SPEC
strategies.guidance: Before any write, call show_api_doc for file_system.login, show_directory, and compression/move APIs. Login, then operate only on absolute paths returned by show_directory.
